features.title: Fundraising
features.desc: We raise funds transparently, ensuring every naira goes directly to the families and communities who need it most.

features.title: Donation Making
features.desc: Our donation system is secure, efficient, and built around trust — with regular impact reports for every contributor.

features.title: Volunteer Initiatives
features.desc: We mobilise skilled volunteers from across Nigeria and beyond to deliver hands-on support in underserved communities.

missionVisionValues.intro: Three pillars that define who we are, what we are working towards, and the principles that guide every decision we make.

mission.title: Mission
mission.desc: To promote and protect the rights of women and girls through advocacy, empowerment, mentoring, and leadership development, working to eliminate gender-based violence.

vision.title: Vision
vision.desc: We envision a world where every woman and girl knows her worth, claims her rights, and lives free from injustice, discrimination, and inequality.

items.q: What Motivates You To Donate To Our Charity?
items.a: Every donation to Ochaworth directly funds life-changing programmes in education, healthcare, and community development. We publish detailed impact reports so you can see exactly where your naira goes — from school supplies to medical outreaches to vocational training for youth.

items.q: How Did You Hear About Our Organisation?
items.a: Ochaworth has been reaching communities across Nigeria and beyond for over a decade. You may have discovered us through a community event, social media, a partner organisation, or a friend who has experienced our work firsthand.

items.q: How Frequently Do You Prefer To Volunteer?
items.a: Volunteering schedules are flexible and tailored to your availability. Whether you can commit to a one-day outreach or a six-month programme, we have a role that fits your skills and calendar. Reach out to our volunteer coordination team to find your best fit.

items.q: What Types Of Projects Does Ochaworth Focus On?
items.a: Our core programme areas include food distribution, child education, medical support, leadership development, poverty reduction, and emergency relief. Every project is designed with community input to ensure it addresses real, local needs.
